hypothesis: A phase-matched dataset selected by source-opening-group round-robin coverage may improve playing score over immutable Seed 599 B512 while using the same number of unique states and unchanged authenticated teacher targets.

feasibility.selection_algorithm: Within each original phase, order groups by SHA256('seed615-group:615:<phase>:<source>:<opening_id>') and group members by SHA256('seed615-state:615:<phase>:<canonical_identity>'); select one row per group in rounds until quota, skipping exhausted groups; break hash ties lexicographically; fail closed if phase capacity is insufficient; sort final membership by (phase, canonical_identity).

control.name: B512
control.treatment_status: fixed immutable checkpoint; no retraining or checkpoint selection

treatment.name: Seed 615 source-opening-diversified policy
treatment.initialization: Reload the exact P-E4 checkpoint and create a fresh Adam optimizer.
treatment.loss: masked policy cross-entropy only; no value loss
treatment.batch_index_schedule: Use the published Seed 599 B 512-batch index schedule unchanged for both memberships; indexes address rows in each membership's frozen sorted order.
prohibitions: No update-budget search or training beyond exactly 512 updates.
No changes to architecture, frozen value parameters, optimizer, learning rate, batch count, batch-index schedule, or training targets.

cohort.generation: Uniform legal-move sampling for prefixes of exactly 12 legal moves using Python random.Random(6150615); reject terminal resulting states and canonical/production-float32 overlap with all authenticated eligible/held-out source states and Seed 599/604 registered evaluation roots; require roots unique in both identity schemes.
cohort.assignment_order: opening, B512 then S615, candidate seat 0 then 1
cohort.game_seed_derivation: SHA-256 of UTF-8 seed615 NUL opening_id NUL candidate NUL seat; first 8 bytes big-endian modulo 2^31

evaluation.comparison: Both fixed B512 and the trained treatment play serving P-E4 on the same registered openings; each opening receives both candidate seats for each comparison.

search.value_evaluator: unchanged serving P-E4 for both candidate policies

bootstrap.resampling: For each replicate sample 1,024 opening-cluster indices with replacement; apply those opening indices jointly to paired candidate/comparison score vectors and retain both seat-swapped outcomes within each selected opening.

primary_confirmatory_test.contrast: treatment minus fixed B512 seat-averaged playing score
primary_confirmatory_test.interval: paired two-sided 95% opening-cluster bootstrap confidence interval
primary_confirmatory_test.cluster: opening; preserve the two seat-swapped outcomes for each model comparison
primary_confirmatory_test.pass_rule: lower endpoint strictly greater than zero

separate_serving_strength_gate.contrast: treatment versus serving P-E4 seat-averaged score
separate_serving_strength_gate.bound: one-sided 95% paired opening-cluster bootstrap lower confidence bound

pre_registration_precision_assessment.interpretation: Conservative distribution-free bounds at 1,024 opening clusters; 20,000 bootstrap resamples specify the registered quantile computation and do not reduce sampling uncertainty.

authorization.training: requires separate explicit owner authorization bound to a future training execution freeze
authorization.evaluation: requires separate explicit owner authorization bound to a future evaluation execution freeze
